question: How does the fivefold nature appear even within the power of will?
premises: Each emanation is necessarily of the nature of the five powers.
The power of will can abide in its own essential form.
In that self-abiding mode it appears as a single, uniform nature.
inference: Even the will-power contains the fivefold structure, though it may appear as one when resting in itself.
uncertainties: The verse is syntactically compressed and continues into the next verse.
plain_english: Each case is necessarily of the nature of the five powers; thus, when the power of will abides in its own nature, it appears clearly as one.
